stages.name: Lung progenitor specification (CBRa)
stages.base_medium: cSFDM (IMDM/Ham's F12 3:1 + B-27 and N-2 supplements, BSA, monothioglycerol, ascorbic acid, GlutaMAX)

factors.name: CHIR99021
factors.role: Wnt activation; specifies NKX2-1+ lung fate

factors.name: Retinoic acid
factors.role: Required for lung specification; add fresh, protect from light

stages.feeding: Every 48 h (more often if the medium yellows)
actions: Feed until day 14-16, then sort NKX2-1+ cells by reporter or by surface markers
stages.checkpoint: NKX2-1+ fraction scored by reporter or intracellular flow; highly line-dependent

stages.name: Airway organoids
stages.base_medium: cSFDM (IMDM/Ham's F12 3:1 + B-27 and N-2 supplements, BSA, monothioglycerol, ascorbic acid, GlutaMAX) in 3D Matrigel

factors.name: FGF2
factors.role: Airway (proximal) differentiation in the absence of Wnt activation

stages.feeding: Every 2-3 days
actions: Replate sorted cells in Matrigel droplets
stages.checkpoint: At about day 30, 30% to >90% of cells remain NKX2-1+ and about half of those are TP63+

stages.name: Basal cell maturation
stages.feeding: Every 2-3 days
actions: Reporter lines: sort NKX2-1+/TP63+ cells at about day 30; non-reporter lines: skip the sort
Replate 20,000 cells per 25-50 µL Matrigel droplet (400-800 cells/µL) in FGF2+FGF10+DCI+Y medium, switch to basal cell medium the next day
Culture about 9 days or longer
stages.checkpoint: NGFR+ EpCAM+ basal cells by flow

stages.name: Air-liquid-interface differentiation
stages.base_medium: PneumaCult-ALI on Matrigel-coated 6.5 mm Transwell inserts
stages.feeding: Per the PneumaCult-ALI instructions
actions: Sort NGFR+ (and EpCAM+) basal cells at about day 40
Seed 150,000-200,000 sorted cells per insert in basal cell medium
When confluent, switch to ALI medium and remove apical medium
Differentiate about 3 weeks
stages.checkpoint: Pseudostratified epithelium with ciliated, secretory and basal cells

protocols.name: Epithelial-only airway organoids by Wnt withdrawal (Kotton lab)
protocols.principle: Lowering canonical Wnt signalling after NKX2-1+ progenitor specification proximalises the cells: sorted progenitors grown in Matrigel with FGF2, FGF10, dexamethasone, cAMP and IBMX form airway spheres of secretory and basal cells. Protocol version of McCauley et al. 2017 (Cell Stem Cell, PMID 28366587).
protocols.efficiency: About 40-90% of sphere cells NKX2-1+ two weeks after sorting; most cells SOX2+
protocols.start_requirements: hPSC adapted to feeder-free mTeSR1 culture; about 2 x 10^6 cells per well of a 6-well plate are needed for each well of endoderm.
tips: Ciliated cells do not form in the spheres unless Notch is inhibited or the cells are moved to air-liquid interface.
Judge lung identity by NKX2-1 co-expression; TP63, CFTR, mucins and keratins alone are not lung-specific.
pitfalls: Line-to-line variability in NKX2-1 induction is high.
NKX2-1-negative cells can expand in the spheres and may be non-lung endoderm.
unverified: Dexamethasone, cAMP and IBMX final concentrations are inferred from the same lab's stock scheme (50 nM; 0.1 mM each); the medium recipe in this paper lists volumes only.
Feeding interval was not captured.
Stage 1 media were not re-read in this paper.

protocols.name: Growth-factor-only route to CFTR-expressing airway epithelium on Transwells (Rossant lab)
protocols.principle: Endoderm is induced directly on collagen IV-coated Transwells, anteriorised with FGF2 and sonic hedgehog, specified to lung progenitors with FGF10, KGF and BMP4, expanded with FGF10/FGF7/FGF18, and matured in commercial bronchial media at air-liquid interface. No sorting is needed.
protocols.start_requirements: hPSC dissociated to single cells and seeded onto Transwell inserts (0.4 µm pores) pre-coated with human placental collagen IV; induction starts immediately.
tips: Useful where a sorter is not available; the Nature Protocols update (Wong 2015, PMID 25654755) is paywalled and was not read.
pitfalls: CFTR-mediated iodide efflux was detected in only a minority of cultures in the paper (for example 4 of 13 H9 cultures).
Lung identity was not purified, so non-lung endoderm contaminates the cultures.
unverified: Base medium for the two FGF10-containing stages and all feeding intervals were not captured.
No purity figure was captured.

cell_types.name: Primordial germ cell-like cells (hPGCLC)
cell_types.summary: Primordial germ cells are the embryonic founders of sperm and eggs, set aside around weeks 2-3 of human development. hPGCLCs made from iPSCs are used to study human germline specification, epigenetic reprogramming and infertility, and are the starting point for attempts to make oogonia and prospermatogonia in culture.
cell_types.maturation_note: hPGCLCs appear within 2-4 days of BMP exposure and correspond to early, pre-migratory PGCs; they stop expanding after about 5 days in the aggregates. Further maturation to oogonia-like cells needed about 4 months of aggregation culture with mouse fetal ovarian somatic cells (Yamashiro 2018 Science, PMID 30237246).

morphology.endpoint: Small floating aggregates in 96-well plates; hPGCLCs cannot be told apart by phase contrast and sit as one or a few clusters inside the aggregate, visible only with a reporter or after staining.

stages.label: Pluripotent colonies
stages.look: Flat compact colonies (primed cultures) or cultures kept in 4i medium on feeders.

stages.label: Competent precursor layer
stages.look: After activin A plus CHIR99021 the cells form a flatter, more spread monolayer with distinct cell borders (iMeLC / pre-mesendoderm).

stages.label: Fresh aggregates
stages.look: One small round aggregate per well of a low-binding 96-well plate.

stages.label: hPGCLC-containing aggregates
stages.look: Aggregates have grown and loosened; reporter-positive hPGCLCs form a cluster within them.

markers.name: SOX2
markers.note: Switched off in human PGCs and hPGCLCs (unlike mouse); a useful negative marker.

markers.name: TBXT
markers.note: Moderately up in competent precursors; low in specified hPGCLCs.

markers.name: EOMES
markers.note: Primitive-streak gene that rises during the pre-induction step.

markers.name: SOX17
markers.note: Key specifier of human PGC fate; first germline factor detected.

markers.name: PRDM1
markers.note: Follows SOX17; represses somatic and endoderm genes. Used as a tdTomato reporter in the Sasaki system.

markers.name: TFAP2C
markers.note: Triple SOX17/PRDM1/TFAP2C positivity defines hPGCLCs; EGFP reporter in the Sasaki system.

markers.name: NANOS3
markers.note: Germline-specific; used as an mCherry or tdTomato knock-in reporter in the Surani-lab protocols.

markers.name: POU5F1
markers.note: Stays on in hPGCLCs, so it does not distinguish them from undifferentiated cells on its own.

markers.name: NANOG
markers.note: Retained and increased in SOX17/PRDM1-positive cells.

markers.name: ALPL
markers.note: Sort with CD38 to isolate hPGCLCs without a reporter.

markers.name: CD38
markers.note: Absent on hESCs; about half of NANOS3-positive cells were CD38+ on day 4 and about 70% on day 5 in Irie 2015.

markers.name: ITGA6
markers.note: Used with EpCAM for reporter-free sorting in the Sasaki system.

markers.name: EPCAM
markers.note: Partner of ITGA6 for reporter-free sorting.

markers.name: FOXA2
markers.note: Endoderm marker; appears if SOX17 acts without enough PRDM1.

functional_assays: Flow cytometry for TNAP/CD38 or ITGA6/EpCAM double-positive cells
Onset of germline epigenetic reprogramming (fall in UHRF1 and DNMT3A, rise in TET1 and 5hmC)
Long-term maturation in aggregates with mouse fetal ovarian somatic cells (specialist assay)
qc: Cells co-express SOX17, PRDM1 and TFAP2C and have lost SOX2
A distinct TNAP+/CD38+ (or ITGA6+/EpCAM+) population is present by day 4 of aggregate culture

protocols.name: iMeLC route (activin A + CHIR, then BMP4 aggregates)
protocols.principle: Primed hiPSCs are first pushed for about two days into incipient mesoderm-like cells (iMeLCs) with activin A and a WNT agonist, which makes them competent; the cells are then aggregated in BMP4 with SCF, EGF and LIF to specify hPGCLCs.
protocols.start_requirements: Feeder-free primed hiPSCs passaged as single cells (the original work used laminin-511 E8 fragment and StemFit medium; not confirmed from the full text). Plates coated with fibronectin for the iMeLC step.
tips: The length of the iMeLC step matters: competence is transient
Without a BLIMP1/TFAP2C reporter line, sort ITGA6+/EpCAM+ cells
A step-by-step version extending to oogonia is Yamashiro et al. 2020 Nat Protoc (PMID 32231324, DOI 10.1038/s41596-020-0297-5)
pitfalls: Induction efficiency varies widely between hiPSC lines and clones
LIF is given in units, not ng/ml; check the unit definition of your supplier
unverified: Sasaki 2015 full text was not accessible (cell.com blocks automated access). All concentrations, the 5 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 density, 44-48 h timing and 5,000 cells per well are taken from Kojima et al. 2021 Life Sci Alliance (PMID 33608411, PMC7918644), a paper from the same laboratory that states the induction was done as described previously
The original paper's cells per aggregate (may differ from 5,000), its reported efficiency, and the hiPSC maintenance conditions are not confirmed

source.authors: Sasaki K, Yokobayashi S, Nakamura T, et al.
source.title: Robust In Vitro Induction of Human Germ Cell Fate from Pluripotent Stem Cells

stages.name: iMeLC induction
stages.base_medium: GK15: GMEM + 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, penicillin-streptomycin, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol

factors.name: Y-27632
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor; survival after single-cell plating

stages.feeding: No change reported; 44-48 h
actions: Plate single hiPSCs at 5 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 on fibronectin-coated wells in the induction medium
Culture for 44-48 h
stages.checkpoint: Flat, epithelial-looking sheet; do not extend beyond 48 h

stages.name: hPGCLC induction in aggregates
stages.base_medium: GK15: GMEM + 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, penicillin-streptomycin, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol
stages.feeding: Medium not changed up to day 6 of induction
actions: Dissociate iMeLCs to single cells with TrypLE Select
Seed 5,000 cells per well in 100 µl in a low-cell-binding V-bottom 96-well plate
Analyse aggregates by flow cytometry between day 2 and day 6 of induction
stages.checkpoint: Reporter-positive or ITGA6+/EpCAM+ cells detectable from about day 2 of induction

protocols.name: 4i competent state, then BMP cytokine embryoids
protocols.principle: hESCs or hiPSCs held in '4i' medium (inhibitors of GSK3, MEK, p38 and JNK with LIF, bFGF and TGF-beta1) are reversibly competent for germ cell fate; a two-day pre-induction or direct aggregation in BMP2/BMP4 with LIF, SCF and EGF gives hPGCLCs.
protocols.efficiency: About 27% NANOS3-mCherry/TNAP double-positive cells by day 4-5 after pre-induction; about 46% when induced directly from 4i cells; about 31% TNAP/CD38 double-positive from a 4i hiPSC line; about 0-5% from conventional bFGF cultures
protocols.start_requirements: Cells kept for more than 2 weeks in 4i medium on irradiated MEFs: knockout DMEM, 20% KSR, 2 mM L-glutamine, 0.1 mM NEAA, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 20 ng/ml human LIF, 8 ng/ml bFGF, 1 ng/ml TGF-beta1, 3 µM CHIR99021, 1 µM PD0325901, 5 µM SB203580, 5 µM SP600125. Passage every 3-5 days with TrypLE Express; 10 µM Y-27632 for 24 h after passage.
materials: Human LIF, bFGF, TGF-beta1, activin A
tips: Cells can be induced directly from 4i culture without the pre-induction step, with a higher yield in the paper
TNAP plus CD38 allows sorting without a reporter
Competence is reversible: it is lost after more than 2 weeks back in conventional medium
pitfalls: hPGCLCs do not proliferate appreciably after about day 5
Long-term culture in kinase-inhibitor media can affect genome and epigenome stability; keep karyotype checks up to date (general caution, not from this paper)
unverified: Medium change schedule during the embryoid step is not stated
Day numbers here count pre-induction as days 0-2 and embryoid culture as days 2-7 (the paper counts embryoid days from 1)

source.authors: Irie N, Weinberger L, Tang WW, et al.
source.title: SOX17 is a critical specifier of human primordial germ cell fate

stages.name: Pre-induction

factors.name: bFGF
factors.role: Primes towards a post-implantation epiblast-like state

factors.name: TGF-beta1 or activin A
factors.conc: 1 ng/ml TGF-beta1 or 20 ng/ml activin A

stages.feeding: Change medium on day 1
actions: Dissociate 4i cells with TrypLE Express and pass through a 50 µm filter
Plate 4 x 10^5 cells per well of a 12-well plate coated with vitronectin/gelatin
stages.checkpoint: Cells attach and spread as a monolayer

stages.name: hPGCLC induction in embryoids
stages.base_medium: GMEM + 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, penicillin-streptomycin, 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mM sodium pyruvate
stages.feeding: Not stated

Analyse by flow cytometry on day 4-5 of embryoid culture

protocols.name: 12 h pre-mesendoderm from conventional E8 cultures, then BMP embryoids
protocols.principle: Conventional primed hPSCs pass through a short window of germline competence about 12 h into mesendoderm induction with activin A and CHIR99021; aggregating the cells at that point in BMP with LIF, SCF and EGF gives hPGCLCs without any need for 4i culture.
protocols.start_requirements: hPSCs on vitronectin in Essential 8, passaged every 3-5 days as clumps with 0.5 mM EDTA.
tips: Timing of the pre-induction is the critical variable: 12 h gives germline competence, 24 h gives mesendoderm that makes endoderm or mesoderm instead
aRB27 as the embryoid base medium improved efficiency over GK15 for Pre-ME cells
BMP2 alone induces hPGCLCs but they do not survive extended culture without LIF, SCF and EGF
pitfalls: Letting pre-induction run past about 18 h sharply lowers yield
unverified: No single efficiency figure was extracted from the text (values are in figures)
Medium change schedule during embryoid culture is not stated
Note the LIF dose here (10 ng/ml) differs from Irie 2015 (1 µg/ml) as printed in the two papers

source.authors: Kobayashi T, Zhang H, Tang WWC, et al.
source.title: Principles of early human development and germ cell program from conserved model systems

stages.name: Pre-mesendoderm (Pre-ME) induction
stages.base_medium: aRB27: Advanced RPMI 1640 + 1% B27, 0.1 mM NEAA, penicillin-streptomycin, 2 mM L-glutamine
stages.feeding: Single 12 h exposure
actions: Trypsinise to single cells
Seed 200,000 cells per well of a vitronectin-coated 12-well plate in induction medium
Harvest at 12 h; competence peaks at about 12 h and declines from about 18 h
stages.checkpoint: Moderate rise in primitive-streak genes (TBXT, MIXL1, EOMES) with only a slight fall in SOX2

stages.name: hPGCLC induction in embryoids
stages.feeding: Not stated
actions: Trypsinise Pre-ME cells and seed 4,000 cells per well in ultra-low attachment or PrimeSurface 96V plates
Analyse on day 4 of embryoid culture
stages.checkpoint: SOX17 appears by 12 h, TFAP2C by about 18 h; a cluster of SOX17/PRDM1/TFAP2C-positive cells sits in the middle of the embryoid by 48 h

cell_types.notes: hPGCLCs are an early germ cell state, not gametes. Efficiency is strongly line- and clone-dependent, and reporter lines or surface-marker sorting are needed to purify the cells. The three protocols differ mainly in how germline competence is obtained (iMeLC, 4i or a 12 h pre-mesendoderm step); BMP is the common inducer. Check local rules on human germline research before starting.

cell_types.name: Primordial germ cell-like cells
cell_types.summary: PGCLCs are the in vitro counterpart of nascent mouse primordial germ cells, induced from epiblast-like cells with a high dose of BMP4 in floating aggregates. They are the entry point to in vitro gametogenesis: transplanted into germ-cell-less testes they give fertile sperm, and aggregated with embryonic gonadal somatic cells they go on to make oocytes.
cell_types.maturation_note: Freshly induced cells correspond roughly to E9.5 migratory germ cells and arrest there; going further needs expansion culture on steel-factor feeders or reaggregation with embryonic gonadal somatic cells.

morphology.endpoint: Compact, smooth floating aggregates a few hundred micrometres across, with the germline cells sitting as a bright cluster that is obvious only with a reporter or after staining; the rest of the aggregate is somatic.

stages.label: Naive ESC colonies
stages.look: Round, domed, tightly packed colonies in 2i+LIF.

stages.label: Epiblast-like monolayer
stages.look: Flat, even, sub-confluent sheet on fibronectin at the competence window.

stages.label: Early floating aggregates
stages.look: Cells coalesce at the bottom of the U-bottom well into a single loose ball within the first day.

stages.label: Germline-containing aggregates
stages.look: Smooth, compact spheres; under fluorescence a discrete reporter-bright cluster marks the germline population.

stages.label: Expanded germ cells on feeders
stages.look: Small, round, refractile cells growing in loose clumps on a flat feeder layer.

markers.name: Prdm1
markers.note: The founding germline determinant; the Blimp1-mVenus reporter is the standard live readout.

markers.name: Dppa3
markers.note: Second-wave germline marker; the Stella-ECFP reporter comes up after Blimp1-mVenus.

markers.name: Prdm14
markers.note: Germline factor; on its own it suffices to push epiblast-like cells to a germline state.

markers.name: Tfap2c
markers.note: Third member of the germline transcription factor trio.

markers.name: Nanos3
markers.note: Germ-cell-specific gene, upregulated in induced germline cells.

markers.name: Dnd1
markers.note: Germ-cell RNA-binding protein, upregulated.

markers.name: Nanog
markers.note: Unusually, pluripotency genes come back up in germline cells rather than switching off.

markers.name: Sox2
markers.note: Also re-expressed in the germline population.

markers.name: Itgb3
markers.note: With SSEA1, lets germline cells be sorted without a reporter and away from tumorigenic undifferentiated cells.

markers.name: Fut4
markers.note: Surface marker used together with integrin-beta3 for sorting.

markers.name: Dnmt3b
markers.note: De novo methyltransferase, downregulated as the germline epigenome is reset.

markers.name: Uhrf1
markers.note: Also downregulated, part of the methylation-maintenance shutdown.

markers.name: Hoxb1
markers.note: Somatic Hox gene; stays low in germline cells, unlike neighbouring somatic cells in the aggregate. (Marks: Somatic mesoderm.)

markers.name: Ddx4
markers.note: Comes on only after the cells reach a gonadal environment, not in freshly induced aggregates. (Marks: Gonadal germ cell.)

functional_assays: Transplantation into germ-cell-deficient testes and scoring spermatogenesis
Reaggregation with embryonic gonadal somatic cells (reconstituted testis or ovary)
Genome-wide DNA methylation measurement during expansion
Embryonic germ cell colony-forming assay
qc: Germline reporter (Blimp1-mVenus) bright with Stella-ECFP only beginning, at about 90 h of induction, when expansion potential is best (Ishikura 2022)
Expansion culture should give more than an 8-fold increase in cell number (Ishikura 2022); Ohta 2017 reports ~20-fold on average and up to ~50-fold
Sorted population free of reporter-negative cells, which otherwise carry tumorigenic undifferentiated cells into transplants

protocols.name: Cytokine-induced PGCLCs from EpiLC aggregates (BMP4 + LIF + SCF + EGF)
protocols.principle: Day-2 EpiLCs are aggregated in serum-free GK15 medium with a high dose of BMP4 plus LIF, SCF and EGF, reproducing the signal the extraembryonic ectoderm gives the proximal epiblast in vivo; germline cells appear inside the floating aggregates over about four to six days.
protocols.start_requirements: EpiLCs induced for ~44-48 h from 2i+LIF ESCs on fibronectin (activin A 20 ng/ml, bFGF 12 ng/ml, 1% KSR in N2B27); dissociate to single cells immediately before aggregation.
materials: Anti-SSEA1 and anti-integrin-beta3 antibodies for sorting
tips: Integrin-beta3 (Itgb3) together with SSEA1 lets germline cells be isolated without a reporter line, and separates them from undifferentiated, tumorigenic cells.
BMP8a is in the original cytokine cocktail, but several later groups report good induction without it - worth testing both for your line.
pitfalls: Using EpiLCs outside the competence window, which is the dominant failure mode.
Dissociation that leaves clumps, giving uneven aggregates.
Carrying undifferentiated cells into transplantation experiments if sorting is skipped.
unverified: All concentrations here come from open-access papers restating Hayashi 2011 (Sugawa 2015 EMBO J for BMP4 500 ng/ml, BMP8a 500 ng/ml, SCF 100 ng/ml, EGF 50 ng/ml, LIF 10^3 U/ml and 1 x 10^3 EpiLCs per well; Nady 2015 eLife for 1,000-2,000 cells per aggregate and GK15 composition); the Cell 2011 full text was not accessible in this session.
The exact cells-per-aggregate number used in the original paper is not confirmed (restating papers give 1,000-2,000).
The induction efficiency (percent reporter-positive cells) reported in the original paper could not be read.
Whether the original used Lipidure-coated or other low-binding plates is not confirmed.

source.authors: Hayashi K, Ohta H, Kurimoto K, Aramaki S, Saitou M
source.title: Reconstitution of the mouse germ cell specification pathway in culture by pluripotent stem cells

stages.name: EpiLC induction

factors.name: KnockOut Serum Replacement
factors.role: Low KSR; higher levels reduce germline yield

stages.feeding: Medium changed once at 24 h
actions: Plate ESCs on fibronectin in EpiLC induction medium
Harvest at ~44-48 h, at the peak of germline competence
stages.checkpoint: Sub-confluent flat monolayer at the calibrated time point

stages.name: Floating aggregation with BMP4
stages.base_medium: GK15 (GMEM, 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 2 mM L-glutamine, antibiotics)

factors.name: BMP4
factors.role: Germline-inducing signal, standing in for extraembryonic ectoderm

factors.name: BMP8a
factors.role: Added in the original Cell 2011 formulation; several later labs omit it

factors.name: SCF
factors.role: KIT ligand; germ cell survival and proliferation

stages.feeding: Aggregates set up once in low-binding U-bottom 96-well plates and left to float
actions: Dissociate EpiLCs with TrypLE and count
Aggregate about 1,000-2,000 EpiLCs per well in low-cell-binding U-bottom 96-well plates
Culture as floating aggregates for 4-6 days
Dissociate aggregates and sort germline cells by reporter fluorescence or by surface markers
stages.checkpoint: Compact floating aggregates with a reporter-positive cluster; day-6 cultures are the ones sorted in the original work

protocols.name: Day-4 PGCLCs and feeder expansion (STAR Protocols version)
protocols.principle: A tightened version of the cytokine route: a fixed number of EpiLCs is aggregated in BMP4-containing medium, and the aggregates are harvested at about 90 h, when the germline reporter is bright but the second reporter has only just begun - the window in which the cells still expand on feeders.
protocols.start_requirements: EpiLCs at 44 h of induction (from 1.0 x 10^5 ESCs per fibronectin-coated 12-well in N2B27 + activin A 20 ng/ml + bFGF 12 ng/ml + 1% KSR), dissociated with TrypLE Express into single cells.
materials: GMEM, KSR, FBS, NEAA, pyruvate, 2-mercaptoethanol, L-glutamine
Blimp1-mVenus / Stella-ECFP / Mvh-RFP reporter ESC line
tips: The right cells-per-aggregate number is line-dependent; this protocol works at 4,000 per well for its reference line and suggests testing 2,000-5,000.
Add DNase I during dissociation - DNA from dead cells makes sticky clumps that wreck the sort.
Feeder density matters as much as the germline cell density for expansion.
pitfalls: Harvesting aggregates too late: fully double-reporter-positive cells expand poorly.
Overgrown m220-5 feeders lose their supporting capacity.
A loose FACS gate carries reporter-negative cells into the expansion culture.
unverified: No percentage induction efficiency for the aggregates is stated in this protocol (its quantified endpoint is the expansion fold-change).

source.authors: Ishikura Y, Ohta H, Nagano M, Saitou M
source.title: Optimized protocol to derive germline stem-cell-like cells from mouse pluripotent stem cells

stages.name: EpiLC induction
stages.feeding: 1 ml per 12-well, changed at 24 h
actions: Seed 1.0 x 10^5 ESCs per fibronectin-coated 12-well
Change medium at 24 h and culture a further ~20 h
stages.checkpoint: Sub-confluent (~1 x 10^6 cells per 12-well) at 44 h

stages.name: Germline induction in aggregates
stages.base_medium: GMEM with 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 2 mM L-glutamine, pen/strep
stages.feeding: 100 ul per well, set up once and left for the whole induction
actions: Resuspend dissociated EpiLCs at 4,000 cells per 100 ul (4 x 10^4 cells/ml)
Transfer 100 ul per well into Nunclon Sphera 96-well microplates
Incubate about 90-96 h without feeding
stages.checkpoint: At ~90 h the aggregates carry a bright Blimp1-mVenus signal with Stella-ECFP only just starting; fully double-positive aggregates have already lost expansion potential

stages.name: Sorting and expansion on feeders
stages.base_medium: GMEM with 10% KSR, 2.5% FBS, 0.1 mM NEAA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 2 mM L-glutamine, pen/strep

factors.name: SCF
factors.role: Membrane-bound and soluble KIT ligand drive proliferation

factors.name: Forskolin
factors.role: Raises cAMP; with rolipram this is what makes the cells expand

factors.name: Cyclosporin A
factors.role: Included in the culture medium of this protocol

stages.feeding: 500 ul per well of a 24-well plate; half the medium changed on culture days 1 and 3
actions: Dissociate the aggregates with trypsin plus DNase I under a stereomicroscope
Sort reporter-positive cells by FACS with a stringent gate
Plate 5 x 10^3 sorted cells in 500 ul onto mitomycin-C-treated m220-5 feeders in a 24-well plate
Culture 120 h, changing half the medium on days 1 and 3
stages.checkpoint: Typically more than an 8-fold increase in cell number over the expansion culture

protocols.name: PGCLC expansion with forskolin and rolipram
protocols.principle: Sorted day-4 germline cells are expanded on steel-factor-presenting feeders with two drugs that raise cAMP by different routes; during this expansion the cells erase their DNA methylome, reproducing the epigenetic reset of gonadal germ cells.
protocols.efficiency: Expansion of roughly 20-fold on average and up to about 50-fold
protocols.start_requirements: Day-4 PGCLCs sorted from BMP4-induced EpiLC aggregates (GK15 with BMP4 500 ng/ml, LIF 1,000 U/ml, SCF 100 ng/ml, EGF 50 ng/ml), isolated on Blimp1-mVenus and Stella-ECFP fluorescence.
tips: The expanded cells keep spermatogenic capacity and have been used to rescue fertility in infertile mice.
The point of the expansion is as much epigenetic as numerical: the cells erase genome-wide DNA methylation, including parental imprints.
pitfalls: Feeders not adapted to forskolin and rolipram support expansion less well.
Expanded cells drift if plated too sparsely.
unverified: Cyclosporin A is not mentioned in the methods of this paper (it appears in the later STAR Protocols version).
Numbers come from the PMC full text of this paper read in this session; the cells-per-aggregate number for the induction step is not stated there.

source.authors: Ohta H, Kurimoto K, Okamoto I, Nakamura T, Yabuta Y, Miyauchi H, et al.
source.title: In vitro expansion of mouse primordial germ cell-like cells recapitulates an epigenetic blank slate

stages.name: Germline induction in aggregates
stages.base_medium: GK15 (GMEM, 15% KSR, 0.1 mM NEAA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 2 mM L-glutamine, antibiotics)
stages.feeding: Aggregates floated in low-cell-binding U-bottom 96-well plates (AggreWell400 in the screening experiments)
actions: Induce EpiLCs for 2 days on fibronectin (activin A 20 ng/ml, bFGF 12 ng/ml, 1% KSR)
Aggregate the day-2 EpiLCs in BMP4-containing GK15
Sort day-4 reporter-double-positive cells by FACS
stages.checkpoint: Day-4 aggregates with a clear reporter-positive population for sorting

stages.name: Expansion on steel-factor feeders
stages.base_medium: GMEM with 10% KSR, 2.5% FCS, 0.1 mM NEAA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 2 mM L-glutamine, antibiotics

factors.name: SCF
factors.role: KIT ligand, on top of the membrane-bound form on the feeders

factors.name: Rolipram
factors.role: PDE4 inhibitor; combined with forskolin this is the expansion-driving pair

stages.feeding: Half the medium replaced every 2 days
actions: Plate sorted cells on mitomycin-C-treated m220-5 feeders pre-adapted to forskolin and rolipram
Culture for 7 days, changing half the medium every 2 days
Collect for methylome, transplantation or further differentiation
stages.checkpoint: Cells still reporter-positive and uncommitted in sex after the expansion

cell_types.notes: Almost every failure traces back to the epiblast-like step: the competence window is narrow, KSR must stay at 1%, and the right harvest time has to be found per line. A germline reporter line (Blimp1-mVenus; Stella-ECFP) makes the work far easier, but SSEA1 plus integrin-beta3 sorting is a workable alternative. BMP8a appears in the original cytokine cocktail and is omitted by several later groups - an explicit point of disagreement worth testing in your own hands.

cell_types.name: Amnion-like cells
cell_types.summary: The amnion is the thin squamous epithelium that splits from the epiblast at implantation and encloses the embryo in the amniotic cavity. hPSC-derived amnion-like cells are used to model peri-implantation human development, in particular amniogenesis and the signals the amnion sends to the epiblast.
cell_types.maturation_note: Squamous amnion-like tissue appears 2-4 days after the 3D matrix overlay or within 48 h of BMP4; it corresponds to nascent amnion and is the end point of these cultures.

morphology.endpoint: In 3D, thin-walled cysts made of flattened squamous cells with a single lumen; on Transwell membranes, a flat squamous sheet of large cells.

stages.label: Single cells on matrix
stages.look: Dissociated hPSCs seeded at 30,000 cells/cm^2 on a soft gel bed or on a membrane.

stages.label: Columnar epiblast-like cysts
stages.look: Small cysts with a central lumen and tall columnar walls that still express pluripotency markers.

stages.label: Squamous amnion-like cysts
stages.look: Walls thin out into flat cells with laterally elongated nuclei; more than 90% of cysts are squamous in the Gel-3D condition.

markers.name: NANOG
markers.note: Lost as cysts turn squamous (days 2-4).

markers.name: POU5F1
markers.note: Lost in squamous cysts.

markers.name: SOX2
markers.note: Protein lost; its absence also argues against neuroectoderm.

markers.name: CDH1
markers.note: Retained: the tissue stays epithelial, unlike primitive-streak cells.

markers.name: EZR
markers.note: Apical marker facing the lumen; shows the cysts are polarised.

markers.name: TFAP2A
markers.note: Used as an amnion marker in the Zheng 2019 model.

markers.name: GATA3
markers.note: Up in amnion-like cells but shared with trophoblast.

markers.name: CDX2
markers.note: Present in amnion-like cells; also marks posterior primitive streak and trophoblast.

markers.name: TBXT
markers.note: Transient in incipient amnion-like cells; without SNAI1 induction.

markers.name: BMP4
markers.note: Endogenous BMP4 rises; nuclear phospho-SMAD1/5 accompanies it and BMP inhibition blocks amniogenesis.

markers.name: FOXA2
markers.note: Primitive streak / endoderm; should be undetectable.

markers.name: SOX17
markers.note: With NANOG and TFAP2C would indicate PGC-like cells instead.

functional_assays: Cyst morphology scoring (squamous versus columnar, nuclear aspect ratio, wall thickness)
Phospho-SMAD1/5 staining
Co-culture on Transwell to test induction of primitive-streak-like fate in hPSCs
qc: More than 90% of cysts squamous at day 5 in the Gel-3D condition
Loss of NANOG/OCT4/SOX2 protein with retained E-cadherin

protocols.name: Gel-3D: soft matrix bed plus matrix overlay in mTeSR1
protocols.principle: No inducing factor is added: single hPSCs on a thick, soft basement-membrane gel bed, overlaid with dilute matrix in ordinary mTeSR1, form lumenal cysts that self-organise into squamous amnion-like tissue through endogenous BMP-SMAD signalling. Both the soft bed and the 3D overlay are required.
protocols.efficiency: More than 90% of cysts squamous in Gel-3D (shown for H9, H7, UM63-1 hESCs and one hiPSC line)
protocols.start_requirements: Feeder-free hPSCs in mTeSR1 on Geltrex, free of spontaneously differentiated cells. Prepare glass coverslips carrying a Geltrex gel bed at least 100 µm thick (undiluted Geltrex sandwiched between a treated coverslip and a passivated slide, gelled 30 min at 37 °C, then soaked in DMEM/F12 overnight).
materials: Glass coverslips, poly-L-lysine, glutaraldehyde, PLL-g-PEG (for the gel-bed sandwich)
tips: Gel bed thickness sets the stiffness cells feel: beds of 20 or 60 µm inhibited squamous cyst formation
Controls worth running: the same cells on Geltrex-coated glass without overlay stay as pluripotent colonies
LDN193189 (500 nM on day 2, or days 2 and 3) or NOGGIN (500 ng/ml) blocks amnion-like differentiation and serves as a specificity control
pitfalls: Thin or uneven gel beds give columnar, still-pluripotent cysts
Squamous cysts are the end point; they do not mature further in this system
unverified: Markers named by gene symbol in the paper's text were partly lost in the text version read; the marker list here is limited to those confirmed in Shao 2017 or Zheng 2019

source.authors: Shao Y, Taniguchi K, Gurdziel K, et al.
source.title: Self-organized amniogenesis by human pluripotent stem cells in a biomimetic implantation-like niche

stages.name: Seeding on the gel bed

factors.name: Y-27632
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor; survival of single cells

stages.feeding: Single 24 h step
actions: Dissociate colonies with Accutase (10 min, 37 °C) to single cells
Plate at 30,000 cells/cm^2 on the gel bed in mTeSR1 with Y-27632
stages.checkpoint: Cells attached as singles or small clusters

stages.name: 3D overlay and amniogenesis

factors.name: Geltrex
factors.role: Dilute matrix overlay that supplies the 3D cue

stages.feeding: Replace medium daily, adding 4% Geltrex each time
actions: On day 1 replace with fresh mTeSR1 without Y-27632, supplemented with 4% Geltrex
Feed daily
Analyse on day 5
stages.checkpoint: Columnar cysts turn squamous between days 2 and 4 and lose NANOG and OCT4

protocols.name: BMP4 on Transwell membranes (Transwell-AMLC)
protocols.principle: hPSCs seeded on a Geltrex-coated porous membrane and given BMP4 for 48 h in FGF2-containing Essential 6 medium become amnion-like cells whose transcriptome is close to the amnion-like cells formed in the authors' microfluidic embryonic-sac model.
protocols.start_requirements: Feeder-free hPSCs in mTeSR1. 12-mm Transwell inserts with 0.4 µm pore polyester membrane, coated with 1% Geltrex in DMEM/F12 for 1 h.
tips: In the same paper, a microfluidic device exposing epiblast-like cysts to 50 ng/ml BMP4 from one side gave asymmetric sacs with amnion-like cells at the exposed pole in 92% of cysts by 36 h; that needs custom-made devices
Transwell-AMLCs induce primitive-streak-like and PGC-like cells in co-cultured hPSCs, which is blocked by the WNT secretion inhibitor IWP2 (5 µM)
pitfalls: BMP4 also drives trophoblast-like and mesoderm fates in other contexts; verify identity with several markers
Takes long Accutase treatment (about 1 h) to dissociate for single-cell work
unverified: Seeding density exponent was lost in the text version read ('30 × 10 cells cm'); 30 x 10^3 cells/cm^2 is likely but unconfirmed, so no number is given in the stage
Efficiency (percentage of amnion-like cells on the membrane) not found in the text
Feeding schedule within the 48 h BMP4 step is not stated

source.authors: Zheng Y, Xue X, Shao Y, et al.
source.title: Controlled modelling of human epiblast and amnion development using stem cells

stages.name: Seeding on the membrane
stages.feeding: Single 18 h step
actions: Seed dissociated hPSCs onto the coated insert (density printed as 30 x 10^n cells/cm^2; see unverified)
stages.checkpoint: Attached, even layer

stages.name: BMP4 induction
actions: 18 h after seeding switch to the basal medium with BMP4
After 48 h replace with fresh basal medium; cells can then be used for co-culture
stages.checkpoint: Flat squamous sheet; TFAP2A and CDX2 positive, NANOG negative

cell_types.notes: Amnion-like cells share GATA3, TFAP2A and CDX2 with trophoblast, and the identity of BMP4-treated primed hPSCs (amnion versus trophoblast) is an active debate; rely on morphology, context and a marker panel. Rostovskaya et al. 2022 (Cell Stem Cell 29:744-759, PMID 35439430) describe two waves of amniogenesis from hPSCs but were not worked up as a protocol here.

cell_types.name: Trophoblast (stem cells, syncytio- and extravillous trophoblast)
cell_types.summary: Trophoblasts are the epithelial cells of the placenta: self-renewing cytotrophoblast gives rise to hormone-secreting syncytiotrophoblast and invasive extravillous trophoblast. PSC-derived trophoblast is used to model implantation, placental disorders such as pre-eclampsia, and infection at the maternal-fetal interface without needing placental tissue.
cell_types.maturation_note: BMP4-based conversion of primed cells gives KRT7+ epithelium within 2 days and hormone secretion from about day 5; naive-derived trophectoderm takes 3 days, while stable trophoblast stem cell lines need 5-10 passages. Terminal differentiation adds 6 days (syncytiotrophoblast) or 8 days (extravillous trophoblast).

morphology.endpoint: Trophoblast stem cells grow as tight cobblestone epithelial colonies; syncytiotrophoblast forms large multinucleated patches (or floating cyst-like spheres in 3D); extravillous trophoblast cells are elongated and spindle-shaped.

stages.label: Naive or primed colonies
stages.look: Dome-shaped naive colonies on feeders, or flat primed colonies, depending on the protocol.

stages.label: Flattened trophectoderm-like sheet
stages.look: Cells become polygonal and flat; BMP4-treated primed colonies turn into a KRT7+ epithelium within about 2 days.

stages.label: Trophoblast stem cell colonies
stages.look: Homogeneous cobblestone colonies with bright borders once proliferative hTSCs take over (passage 5-10).

stages.label: Syncytiotrophoblast
stages.look: Fused, multinucleated areas without visible cell borders; in 3D culture, floating syncytial spheres retained on a 40 µm strainer.

stages.label: Extravillous trophoblast
stages.look: Elongated, spindle-shaped, loosely attached cells in Matrigel-containing medium.

markers.name: POU5F1
markers.note: Should be lost.

markers.name: KLF17
markers.note: Naive-state marker; confirms the starting cells and should fall in hTSCs.

markers.name: CDX2
markers.note: Transient: most BAP-treated cells are positive at 24-48 h, then it declines.

markers.name: TACSTD2
markers.note: With ENPEP, identifies naive-derived trophectoderm on day 3 (50-60% double-positive reported).

markers.name: ENPEP
markers.note: Sort TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells before moving to ACE medium.

markers.name: GATA3
markers.note: Pan-trophoblast transcription factor; also expressed in amnion, so not sufficient alone.

markers.name: KRT7
markers.note: Pan-trophoblast marker; nearly all BAP-treated cells positive by 48 h.

markers.name: TFAP2C
markers.note: Trophoblast transcription factor.

markers.name: TP63
markers.note: Cytotrophoblast / stem-cell marker.

markers.name: TEAD4
markers.note: Stem-cell marker; falls on syncytiotrophoblast differentiation.

markers.name: ELF5
markers.note: About 15-fold or more above naive hPSCs in good hTSCs per the Dong & Theunissen protocol.

markers.name: ITGA6
markers.note: ITGA6/EGFR double-positive fraction is the standard hTSC purity readout.

markers.name: CGB3
markers.note: Syncytiotrophoblast hormone; measure hCG in the medium.

markers.name: HLA-G
markers.note: Extravillous trophoblast marker; at least 80% positive expected at day 8 of EVT differentiation.

markers.name: TBXT
markers.note: Mesoderm; appears if FGF/activin signalling is not suppressed during BMP4 treatment.

functional_assays: hCG (and progesterone, PGF) secretion by ELISA
Cell fusion / multinucleation count
Matrigel invasion assay for extravillous trophoblast
Flow cytometry for ITGA6/EGFR (stem cells) and HLA-G (EVT)
qc: At least 80% ITGA6+/EGFR+ cells in naive-derived hTSCs, reaching about 95% at passage 10 or later
At least 80% HLA-G+ cells at day 8 of EVT differentiation
CGB and SDC1 clearly up in syncytiotrophoblast relative to hTSCs

protocols.name: BAP: BMP4 with activin and FGF inhibitors (primed cells)
protocols.principle: Primed hESCs given BMP4 while FGF2 is withdrawn and activin/nodal and FGF signalling are blocked (A83-01 and PD173074) convert quickly and uniformly to a KRT7+ trophoblast-like epithelium that later makes HLA-G+ and hormone-secreting syncytial cells.
protocols.efficiency: More than 40% KRT7+ within 24 h and almost all cells KRT7+ by 48 h with BAP (about 95% by day 4 with BMP4 alone)
protocols.start_requirements: Primed hESCs (H1, H9) on Matrigel in mTeSR1. Passage as clumps with dispase (1 mg/ml, 3 min) at 1:12, about 1.2 x 10^4 cells/cm^2.
tips: Colonies contain HLA-G+ cells by day 3-4 and syncytial areas by day 5-6
Conversion is slower in chemically defined media: about 70% KRT7+ at day 5 with BAP in the defined medium tested
pitfalls: Whether BMP4-treated primed cells are true trophoblast or partly amnion-like is still debated; confirm with several markers
Leaving FGF2 in, or omitting the inhibitors, allows mesoderm (TBXT) to appear
The cells are a differentiating population, not a self-renewing stem cell line
unverified: Details were read through a summarising fetch of the PMC page (the structured full text was empty), not line by line
Day numbering is set here so that BAP addition is day 0; whether the paper's 'day 9' endpoint is counted from BAP addition or from plating was not confirmed

source.authors: Amita M, Adachi K, Alexenko AP, et al.
source.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
source.title: Complete and unidirectional conversion of human embryonic stem cells to trophoblast by BMP4

stages.name: Conditioning in MEF-conditioned medium

factors.name: FGF2
factors.role: Keeps cells undifferentiated for one day in the new medium

stages.feeding: Single 24 h step
actions: The day after plating in mTeSR1, change to MEF-conditioned medium with FGF2
stages.checkpoint: Small undifferentiated colonies

stages.name: BAP treatment
stages.feeding: Change medium daily
actions: Withdraw FGF2 and add BMP4, A83-01 and PD173074
Collect spent medium daily if hormones are to be measured
End most experiments by day 9
stages.checkpoint: Nuclear CDX2 in most cells at day 2; hCG, progesterone and PGF in the medium from about day 5

protocols.name: Naive hPSCs to trophoblast stem cells in Okae hTSC medium, then EVT or STB
protocols.principle: Naive hPSCs placed directly in the trophoblast stem cell medium of Okae et al. (EGF, CHIR99021, TGF-beta inhibitors, valproic acid, ROCK inhibitor) convert over several passages into self-renewing hTSCs; primed cells do not. The hTSCs are then differentiated with the Okae conditions to extravillous trophoblast (NRG1, A83-01, Matrigel) or syncytiotrophoblast (forskolin).
protocols.efficiency: Highly proliferative hTSCs emerge between passage 5 and 10; good cultures are at least 80% ITGA6+/EGFR+ (about 95% from passage 10)
protocols.start_requirements: A confluent well of naive hPSCs in 5i/L/A or PXGL medium on MEF feeders (5% O2). Plates coated with 5 µg/ml collagen IV (at least 3 h or overnight at 37 °C).
tips: Syncytiotrophoblast alternative from the same hTSCs: 2.5 x 10^5 cells per well of an ultra-low attachment 6-well plate in 3 ml 3D STB medium (DMEM/F12 + 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 0.5% penicillin-streptomycin, 0.3% BSA, 1% ITS-X, 50 ng/ml EGF, 2.5 µM Y-27632, 2 µM forskolin, 4% KSR); add another 3 ml on day 3 and collect on a 40 µm strainer on day 6. A 2D version uses 1 x 10^5 cells per well on 2.5 µg/ml collagen IV in the same medium without EGF

The hTSC medium and the EVT/STB conditions are those of Okae et al. 2018 (Cell Stem Cell 22:50-63, PMID 29249463, DOI 10.1016/j.stem.2017.11.004), who derived hTSCs from blastocysts and first-trimester placenta
A step-by-step version is Dong & Theunissen 2022 Methods Mol Biol (PMID 34870832, DOI 10.1007/978-1-0716-1908-7_7)
pitfalls: Primed hPSCs do not give hTSCs in this medium; a well-characterised naive culture is the prerequisite
Expect a slow, heterogeneous phase for the first passages; do not discard early
Day numbers after derivation are nominal: differentiation starts whenever a stable hTSC line is in hand
unverified: The 30-day derivation length is an approximation of '5-10 passages' and is not a figure from the paper
Okae 2018 itself was not read (cell.com blocked); its conditions are given as restated by Dong 2020 and Dong & Theunissen 2022

source.authors: Dong C, Beltcheva M, Gontarz P, et al.
source.title: Derivation of trophoblast stem cells from naïve human pluripotent stem cells

stages.name: hTSC derivation and expansion
stages.base_medium: DMEM/F12 + 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 0.2% FBS, 0.5% penicillin-streptomycin, 0.3% BSA, 1% ITS-X
stages.feeding: Change medium every 2 days
actions: Dissociate naive cells to single cells with TrypLE Express (5 min)
Seed 0.5-1.0 x 10^6 cells per collagen IV-coated well of a 6-well plate in 2 ml hTSC medium; 5% CO2, 20% O2
Passage 1:2 at 80-100% confluence; cells grow slowly for the first few passages
Once homogeneous (5-10 passages), passage every 3 days at 1:4
stages.checkpoint: At least 80% ITGA6+/EGFR+ by flow; ELF5, KRT7 and GATA3 strongly up versus naive cells

stages.name: EVT differentiation, days 0-3
stages.base_medium: DMEM/F12 + 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 0.5% penicillin-streptomycin, 0.3% BSA, 1% ITS-X + 4% KSR

factors.name: Matrigel
factors.role: Matrix signal; add just after resuspending the cells

stages.feeding: Single dose
actions: Seed 0.75 x 10^5 hTSCs per well of a 6-well plate coated with 1 µg/ml collagen IV in 2 ml medium

stages.name: EVT differentiation, days 3-6
stages.base_medium: DMEM/F12 + 0.1 mM 2-mercaptoethanol, 0.5% penicillin-streptomycin, 0.3% BSA, 1% ITS-X + 4% KSR
stages.feeding: Single change on day 3
actions: Replace medium; NRG1 is omitted from day 3

stages.name: EVT differentiation, days 6-8
stages.feeding: Single change on day 6
actions: Replace medium without KSR
Analyse on day 8 of differentiation
stages.checkpoint: At least 80% HLA-G+; HLA-G and MMP2 mRNA strongly up versus hTSCs

protocols.name: Naive hPSCs to trophectoderm in 3 days, then cytotrophoblast in ACE medium
protocols.principle: Naive hPSCs freed of feeders are driven to trophectoderm-like cells (nTE) in three days by blocking MEK/ERK and activin/nodal signalling with a first-day BMP4 pulse and then a JAK inhibitor; sorted TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells become self-renewing cytotrophoblast (nCT) in ACE medium (A83-01, CHIR99021, EGF).
protocols.efficiency: 50-60% TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells on day 3
protocols.start_requirements: Naive hPSCs (H9; also used on 409B2 and AdiPS1 hiPSCs) in t2iLGö medium on MEF feeders, dome-shaped and positive for KLF17, SUSD2 and CD75. Feeders must be removed: dissociate with Accutase (10-15 min) and pre-plate on 0.1% gelatin for 2 h in t2iLGö with 10 µM Y-27632, then collect the floating cells. Wells coated with laminin-511 E8 fragment (iMatrix-511) at 0.15 µg/cm^2.
materials: Anti-TACSTD2 and anti-ENPEP antibodies; cell sorter
tips: The laminin-E8 amount is critical (0.10-0.25 µg/cm^2); more reduces induction
About 0.5-1 x 10^5 double-positive cells are usually recovered per well of a 6-well plate
nCT can be differentiated to syncytiotrophoblast (1 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 in forskolin-containing ST medium, 6 days) or extravillous trophoblast (8 days) following the Okae conditions
The underlying study is Io et al. 2021 Cell Stem Cell 28:1023-1039 (PMID 33831365, DOI 10.1016/j.stem.2021.03.013)
pitfalls: Residual MEFs inhibit trophectoderm induction
Flat, differentiated cells in the naive culture lower efficiency at every later step
Requires a cell sorter and low-oxygen incubator
unverified: The Cell Stem Cell paper itself was not read; all values are from the authors' STAR Protocols version
The 6-day length given to the ACE stage is one passage interval chosen for the timeline, not a fixed endpoint

source.authors: Io S, Iemura Y, Takashima Y
source.title: Optimized protocol for naive human pluripotent stem cell-derived trophoblast induction

stages.name: nTE induction, day 0-1

factors.name: Y-27632
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for the first 24 h

stages.feeding: Single dose (nTE-1 medium)
actions: Seed feeder-depleted naive cells at 2-4 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 on laminin-E8-coated wells

stages.name: nTE induction, day 1-3
stages.feeding: Change daily (nTE-2 medium)
actions: Change to nTE-2 medium on day 1 and again on day 2
On day 3 dissociate with Accutase (20-30 min; the cells stick firmly) and stain for TACSTD2 and ENPEP
stages.checkpoint: Polygonal, flat cells on day 2-3; 50-60% TACSTD2+ENPEP+ on day 3

stages.name: Cytotrophoblast (nCT) in ACE medium

factors.name: Y-27632
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for 24 h after each passage

stages.feeding: Change every 2 days
actions: Sort TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells and seed at 2-4 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 on laminin-E8-coated wells
Passage every 3-6 days with Accutase at 1:3-1:4; maintain in 5% O2
stages.checkpoint: Cobblestone colonies; cells can be maintained beyond 40 passages

cell_types.notes: Starting state matters more here than for any other lineage: naive hPSCs give bona fide trophectoderm and trophoblast stem cells, whereas primed hPSCs need BMP4 (BAP) and give a differentiating, debated population. Setting up naive culture is a project in itself. Human placental trophoblast should be HLA class I-low except HLA-G in EVT; checking several criteria is advised.

other_kits.name: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (one complete medium, days 1-5)
other_kits.principle: A sparse single-cell hPSC monolayer is fed daily with one complete, defined, xeno-free medium that needs no added factors, giving early Brachyury+ OCT4- mesoderm that can be assayed or pushed on to more specialized mesodermal lineages.
other_kits.start_requirements: hPSCs in mTeSR1, TeSR-E8, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF, ready for passage (large compact colonies with dense centres). Single-cell passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent onto Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix or Vitronectin XF at 5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 (5 x 10^5 per 6-well, 2 x 10^5 per 12-well, 1 x 10^5 per 24-well) in maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632; 20-50% confluent on day 1.
materials: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (05220, 100 mL; 05221, 500 mL)
Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (Corning 354277) or Vitronectin XF (07180)
mTeSR1 (85850), TeSR-E8 (05990), mTeSR Plus (100-0276) or TeSR-AOF (100-0401)
Example antibodies: Anti-Human CD56 clone HCD56 (60021), Anti-Human OCT4 clone 3A2A20 (60093)
tips: Thawed medium keeps 1 month at 2-8°C; frozen aliquots keep 2 weeks after thawing. Do not filter it.

factors.name: STEMdiff Neural Organoid Supplement J

stages.feeding: Full medium change on day 13 (3 mL per well)
actions: Day 10: remove all medium without disturbing the droplets and add 3 mL differentiation medium
Move the plate to an orbital shaker in the incubator (65 RPM for a 6-well plate on a 25 mm-throw INFORS Celltron)
Day 13: change the medium and return to the shaker for 2 days
stages.checkpoint: Surface budding expands as choroid plexus epithelium forms

stages.name: Maturation on orbital shaker

factors.name: STEMdiff Neural Organoid Basal Medium 4
factors.role: basal medium, 98 mL per 100 mL (composition proprietary)

actions: Day 15: change to Maturation Medium and keep on the shaker
After day 30 continue with medium from the Maturation Kit (100-0825), adding 1% (v/v) Matrigel to ice-cold medium
Move cystic organoids with a 1 mL tip cut to a ~3 - 5 mm bore

other_kits.name: StemXVivo Mesoderm Kit
other_kits.principle: A defined RPMI-based supplement plus a single pre-mixed growth-factor cocktail pushes a subconfluent hPSC monolayer into brachyury-positive mesoderm in two overnight medium changes, giving germ-layer cells for downstream cardiac, skeletal or haematopoietic protocols.
other_kits.start_requirements: Plates coated with Cultrex PathClear RGF BME or Cultrex UltiMatrix diluted 1:40 in DMEM/F-12 for 1-2 h at room temperature (2.5 mL per 60 mm plate, 0.5 mL per well of a 24-well plate). hPSCs are dissociated with Accutase and replated in ExCellerate iPSC Expansion Medium containing 5 uM Y-27632 at 4-5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 (for example 2 x 10^6 cells spread over one 24-well plate); they should be about 50% confluent the next morning before differentiation starts. One kit makes 100 mL of medium, enough for six 60 mm plates or two 24-well plates.
materials: RPMI (R&D Systems M30150); DMEM/F-12; GlutaminePlus (B90210) or GlutaMAX
Cultrex PathClear RGF BME (3433-005-01) or Cultrex UltiMatrix (BME001)
Y-27632 (Tocris 1254); Accutase; Trypan Blue; sterile PBS; very low endotoxin BSA
Fixation and staining reagents plus a NorthernLights secondary (NL001/NL002/NL003) and mounting medium (CTS011)
tips: Starting at ~50% confluency matters more than the exact seeding number; slow-growing lines should be plated denser
Prepare the differentiation medium fresh for each change
The same cocktail is sold inside the trilineage Functional Identification Kit (SC027B), where it is used on the same two-overnight schedule
pitfalls: Starting from a culture that is already over-confluent biases differentiation and lowers brachyury
Brachyury is transient; fix at the end of the window rather than days later
unverified: No vendor-stated percentage of brachyury-positive cells
The datasheet gives an endpoint window of 36-52 h while the product page advertises 3 days; duration_days is set to the advertised 3 days

stages.name: Seeding in expansion medium
stages.base_medium: ExCellerate iPSC Expansion Medium with 5 uM Y-27632

factors.name: Cultrex PathClear RGF BME or UltiMatrix (user-supplied)

stages.feeding: Single overnight culture
actions: Coat with 1:40 matrix and leave 1-2 h at room temperature; aspirate just before plating
Dissociate with Accutase, break up clumps and count viable cells
Plate at 4-5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 in expansion medium with 5 uM Y-27632
If the culture is not ~50% confluent next day, refeed and wait rather than starting early
stages.checkpoint: About 50% confluent undifferentiated monolayer

stages.name: Mesoderm Differentiation Media, first overnight
stages.base_medium: Mesoderm Base Media: RPMI with Mesoderm Base Media Supplement (1:50), GlutaMAX, optional penicillin-streptomycin
stages.feeding: One overnight exposure; 5 mL per 60 mm plate or 1 mL per well of a 24-well plate
actions: Reconstitute the differentiation supplement in 0.1% BSA/PBS and dilute 1:500 into pre-warmed base medium
Remove the expansion medium and add the differentiation medium
Incubate overnight

stages.name: Mesoderm Differentiation Media, second change
stages.base_medium: Mesoderm Base Media with Mesoderm Differentiation Supplement

factors.name: Goat Anti-Human Brachyury antibody (kit component)
factors.role: mesoderm marker for ICC, about 1 ug/100 uL

stages.feeding: Repeat the medium change 12-16 h after the first one; cells are ready roughly 36-52 h after differentiation began
actions: Make fresh differentiation medium and change it 12-16 h after the first addition
At 36-52 h take the cells into a downstream protocol or fix for brachyury staining
stages.checkpoint: Nuclear brachyury by ICC or flow; the vendor advertises mesoderm in 3 days

other_kits.name: StemXVivo Ectoderm Kit
other_kits.principle: A defined RPMI-based supplement plus one pre-mixed growth-factor cocktail, changed daily for three nights, converts a subconfluent hPSC monolayer into OTX2-positive ectoderm as a starting point for neural or epidermal protocols.
other_kits.start_requirements: Plates coated with Cultrex PathClear RGF BME diluted 1:40 in DMEM/F-12, 1-2 h at room temperature (2.5 mL per 60 mm plate, 0.5 mL per well of a 24-well plate), matrix removed just before plating. The datasheet protocol uses BG01V hESCs in MEF conditioned medium: Accutase dissociation, then replating at 1.1 x 10^5 cells/cm2 (for example 4.5 x 10^6 cells across one 24-well plate) in MEF conditioned medium containing 4 ng/mL FGF basic, to reach about 50% confluency the next day. No ROCK inhibitor is specified. One kit makes 150 mL of medium.
materials: MEF Conditioned Media (AR005) and Recombinant Human FGF basic, tissue-culture grade (4114-TC)
RPMI; DMEM/F-12; GlutaMAX; optional penicillin-streptomycin; sterile PBS; very low endotoxin BSA
Fixation and staining reagents, NorthernLights secondary (NL001/NL002/NL003), mounting medium (CTS011)
tips: Keep the starting culture at about half confluency; the kit is written around that density
Make the differentiation medium fresh for each of the three daily changes
pitfalls: The protocol was developed on BG01V hESCs in MEF conditioned medium, so feeder-free lines need a density check first
Poor-quality or very high-passage starting cells cut efficiency and increase death
unverified: No vendor-stated percentage of OTX2-positive cells
No feeder-free seeding density or ROCK inhibitor guidance in the datasheet

stages.name: Seeding to ~50% confluency
stages.base_medium: MEF conditioned medium with 4 ng/mL FGF basic
stages.feeding: Overnight culture after plating
actions: Coat plates with 1:40 RGF BME for 1-2 h and aspirate immediately before use
Dissociate with Accutase in small batches and break clumps gently
Plate at 1.1 x 10^5 cells/cm2 and culture overnight
If the culture has not reached ~50% confluency, refeed and wait
stages.checkpoint: About 50% confluent undifferentiated monolayer

stages.name: Ectoderm Differentiation Media, days 1-3
stages.base_medium: Ectoderm Base Media: RPMI with Ectoderm Base Media Supplement (1:50), GlutaMAX, optional penicillin-streptomycin
stages.feeding: Fresh differentiation medium every 12-24 h for three nights; 5 mL per 60 mm plate or 1 mL per well of a 24-well plate
actions: Reconstitute each supplement vial in 150 uL sterile 0.1% BSA/PBS and dilute 1:500 into warm base medium
Replace the stem cell medium with ectoderm differentiation medium and incubate overnight
Repeat the medium change on days 2 and 3, preparing medium fresh

stages.name: Day 4 readout or hand-off

factors.name: Goat Anti-Human Otx2 antibody (kit component)
factors.role: ectoderm marker for ICC, about 1 ug/100 uL

stages.feeding: No further feeding
actions: On day 4 pass the cells into a downstream neural or epidermal protocol, or fix them
Stain for OTX2 with the kit antibody and a NorthernLights secondary, including a no-primary control
stages.checkpoint: OTX2-positive nuclei across the monolayer

other_kits.name: Quick-Neuron Cholinergic - SeV Kit
other_kits.principle: The same temperature-sensitive Sendai virus platform with a cholinergic transcription-factor set: transduction and 33 C culture, puromycin selection, a shift to 37 C on day 2, one passage on day 3, and ChAT-positive neurons by day 7.
other_kits.efficiency: The release specification for the matching ready-made cell product (CH-SeV-HC-CW50065) is over 80% TUBB3+ and over 50% ChAT+/TUBB3+ at day 7; no separate figure is published for user runs with the kit
other_kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. The kit needs about 3.3 x 10^6 viable hPSCs (3 wells of a 6-well plate at 50-70% confluency) and a stable 33 C, 5% CO2 incubator; it covers 6 wells of a 6-well plate.
materials: Quick-Neuron Cholinergic - SeV Kit (CH-SeV): QN-SeV-P, Component N1, Component A, Component P
0.01% poly-L-ornithine (Sigma P4957) and laminin mouse protein natural (Thermo 23017015) or Geltrex (A15696-01) for the replating plate
StemFit Basic04 Complete Type (AMSBio SF041-001), StemFit AK02N or StemFlex (Thermo A3349401)
TrypLE Select Enzyme 1X (Thermo 12563011) and 0.02% EDTA in DPBS (Sigma E8008) for Solution D1
ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (Selleckchem S1049) and DMSO (Sigma D2650)
Optional STEM-CELLBANKER (AMSBIO 11890) for cryopreserving at the day-3 passage
tips: This is the shortest of the Quick-Neuron kits - 7 days from transduction to assay
Mix the Sendai virus by tapping only
Keep Medium N1(A) protected from light
pitfalls: BSL-2 containment is required for the Sendai virus
Starting confluency above 90% or cells less than 14 days post-thaw are ruled out by the guide
The day-3 passage is the fragile step; handle one well at a time
unverified: No purity figure published for user differentiations with the kit itself
The user guide's consumable list cites iMatrix-511 silk as RBI-2040 while other Quick kits cite NI511S for the same item

stages.name: Day -3: plate preparation
stages.feeding: None; hold the coated plate at 4 C
actions: Coat a fresh 6-well plate with 2 mL diluted iMatrix-511 silk per well and keep at 4 C
Prepare Medium N1(A) from Components N1 and A with DMEM/F12, Neurobasal, GlutaMAX and penicillin-streptomycin; keep dark at 4 C for up to 2 weeks

stages.name: Day 0: Sendai virus treatment and plating
stages.base_medium: Medium iN1(A) (Medium N1(A) with 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: QN-SeV-P (undiluted Sendai virus)
factors.role: delivers the cholinergic transcription factors; active at 33 C

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for harvest and plating

stages.feeding: Plate 0.5 x 10^6 cells in 1 mL Medium iN1(A) per well of a 6-well plate
actions: Pre-treat hPSCs 1 h at 37 C in maintenance medium with Y-27632
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 for about 5 min at 37 C and collect in Medium iN1(A)
Bring 3.3 x 10^6 cells plus 10% to 580 uL, add the whole virus vial, tap to mix and hold 10 min at 33 C
Make up to 6.6 mL, plate 1 mL per well and incubate overnight at 33 C

stages.name: Day 1: selection in Medium N1(A)
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well, overnight at 33 C
actions: Replace most of the medium with Medium N1(A) plus puromycin and keep at 33 C

stages.name: Day 2: second selection and shift to 37 C
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well late in the day, then overnight at 37 C
actions: Change the medium in the late afternoon
Move to 37 C to inactivate the virus
stages.checkpoint: Puromycin-treated control cells should be dead

stages.name: Day 3: passage onto ornithine/laminin in Medium iN1(AP)
stages.base_medium: Medium iN1(AP) (Medium N1(A) with Component P and 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: Component P
factors.role: supplement added from the passage onward (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Replate at 5 x 10^5 cells per 6-well, 1 x 10^5 per 24-well or 1.5 x 10^4 per 96-well; total 1 mL, 300 uL or 50 uL
actions: Coat the new plate with 0.002% poly-L-ornithine (2 h, 37 C), wash twice with PBS and coat with diluted laminin (2 h, 37 C)
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 for 3 min at 37 C, collect in 750 uL Medium iN1(AP) with 6-8 gentle pipetting strokes
Count, prepare 1 x 10^6 viable cells/mL and add to wells preloaded with Medium iN1(AP)
Freeze surplus cells in STEM-CELLBANKER if wanted

stages.name: Day 4: medium change to N1(AP)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per 6-well, 800 uL per 24-well or 150 uL per 96-well, then 3 days at 37 C
actions: Replace the medium with Medium N1(AP), optionally after a gentle PBS rinse, and leave for 3 days
stages.checkpoint: Neurons with neurites visible during this window

stages.name: Day 7: assay or continued maturation
stages.base_medium: Quick-Neuron Cholinergic Maintenance Medium (CH-MM) or user's choice

factors.name: Quick-Neuron Cholinergic Maintenance Medium (CH-MM, sold separately)

stages.feeding: Switch to maintenance medium from day 7
actions: Assay or continue maturing the neurons
Confirm identity with TUBB3, ISL1 and ChAT
stages.checkpoint: TUBB3-positive neurons co-expressing ChAT
